```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'mod_dialogue'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(r:MoodleRelease)
WHERE toFloat(r.release) >= 3.9
RETURN p.component, p.name,
       CASE WHEN m IS NOT NULL THEN COLLECT(DISTINCT m.display_name) ELSE [] END AS maintainers,
       p.last_release_ts,
       COLLECT(DISTINCT r.release) AS supported_moodle_releases
ORDER BY p.component
LIMIT 100
```
